headlines.text: Fed set to deliver its first interest-rate hike since 2023 today, with markets pricing in a 92% chance of a quarter-point move.
10-year Treasury yield hits 5.04%, its highest level since 2007, as oil-driven inflation fears mount ahead of the Fed decision.
AI and chip stocks keep sliding after Amodei, Altman and Musk jointly call for a slowdown in frontier AI development.
Crypto's Clarity Act fails a key Senate cloture vote, dealing a major regulatory setback to the digital-asset industry.
Oil and gas prices jump as Houthi attacks intensify, adding fresh inflation pressure just hours before the Fed's rate call.
Apple's John Ternus officially succeeds Tim Cook as CEO, with Cook shifting to executive chairman as the $1,999 iPhone Duo looms.
